description: This file contains the implementation of the LDAPUserSyncAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for synchronizing LDAP users in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for initiating LDAP sync, retrieving sync status, and handling related configuration and error cases.

classes.name: LDAPUserSyncAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for handling LDAP user synchronization operations, including starting sync, retrieving sync status, and handling configuration validations.

methods.name: getLDAPSyncService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LDAPSyncService used for LDAP synchronization operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initiates LDAP user synchronization, updates sync status, and returns the sync status model or throws exceptions if LDAP settings are not configured or sync fails.

methods.name: saveLDAPSyncStatus
methods.description: Persists the LDAP sync status to the database.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the latest LDAP synchronization status information.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the create operation, excluding the ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getOne operation, excluding the ID parameter.
